auditMethod: Manual source-to-claim review. Pinned official documentation or paper versions; arithmetic checks do not establish the truth of vendor training claims.

sources.locator: Sections 1.3 and 2, three-policy formulation; inspected source lines 105-170
supports: Behavior, proximal and current policies have distinct roles
The proximal/behavior weight is frozen for a batch
The current/proximal ratio is the PPO clipping ratio
sources.boundary: The local two-action calculation omits PPO clipping and KL and fixes the context. It does not prove multi-step state or prefix-distribution correction.

sources.locator: Overview, IS/RS components and decoupled/bypass operation modes
supports: Identical weights may yield different backend or precision probabilities
IS weights and rejection masks are separate components
Bypass mode uses the actual rollout policy as proximal policy
sources.boundary: Threshold 1.5 and the displayed distributions are author-supplied. No recommendation of an optimal threshold and no execution of verl, vLLM or FSDP.

sources.locator: Beyond FP8 - training with NVFP4; format and training recipe subsections
supports: E2M1 values, E4M3 block scales and FP32 per-tensor scale
Random Hadamard transforms and gradient stochastic rounding
sources.boundary: The local example uses high-precision scales and nearest E2M1 levels only. It is not an NVFP4 encoder, complete training recipe or hardware kernel.

sources.locator: NVFP4 Pretraining layer table and Open-source data coverage; inspected source lines 70-155
supports: Default linear layers use NVFP4 with explicit BF16 and MXFP8 exceptions
The released pretraining data does not cover the complete internal training blend
sources.boundary: This is a versioned model recipe, not a universal precision rule. No full corpus reconstruction or GPU model training was performed.

sources.version: PDF header 2026-04-03, checked 2026-10-30; URL is publisher-maintained, not a content-addressed archive
supports: Low-precision fprop, dgrad and wgrad GEMMs
Random Hadamard transforms on wgrad inputs and stochastic rounding for gradients
sources.boundary: Vendor training findings and performance are not local measurements. The recipe commit and TE release provide fixed companion references.

supports: Explicit weighted aggregation and holistic implicit judge scoring are distinct
Reference-guided prompt-specific rubrics feed a GRPO loop
Medicine and science are the controlled domains; broader agentic validation remains future work
sources.boundary: The local criteria, binary judgements and nonnegative weights are invented teaching inputs. No implicit judge API calls, GRPO run, benchmark replication or claim that explicit aggregation is universally best.
